scope: Retain the approved Launchpad and exercise its two installer choices in the native wizard navigation regression.

checks.command: Capture Launchpad and its options in both editions on Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland in light and dark appearance. Measure the 615 × 526 default frame and exercise dismissal through the underlying textbox, category tab, application and blank space.

Build Acrylic Glass with the Plasma 6.6, 6.7 and 6.8 SDKs. On 6.7 run tests/acrylic_glass_capture.py with --compositor x11 --identity GradientProbe --material golden-gate --expect changed --popup-islands.
Run the focused launcher preset, edition transition, plasmoid settings and release screenshot regressions. Verify the generated component manifest.
pytest -q tests/test_installer_wizard.py -k native_wizard_navigation_preserves (both edition cases passed in an isolated offscreen Qt session).

coverage_limits: Visual review covers the default grid and light and dark appearances on Wayland. The X11 pixel check exercises compositor rendering. The hidden Search AI popup has no user entry point.
approval: Maintainer approved the paired light and dark Notification Center glass preview.
